context.random_proposal: four IID uniform physical coordinates in the clipped focal +/-50kb domain
context.targets_at_same_site: one identical context and feature graph; sample index used only for output gathering
context.SNP_extent: all SNPs in complete selected native tree intervals, possibly extending beyond50kb

sampling.site_epoch: uniform random permutation of all sites in selected support
sampling.training_loss: M/(S*N) times sum of target losses, where M is support sites,N support canonical rows,S actual minibatch sites
sampling.microbatch_rule: Keep original minibatch M/(S*N) across all microbatches and perform one optimizer update
sampling.evaluation: sum losses and counts over all canonical rows, then divide by N; no equal-site mean

profile.selection: 16 evenly spaced indices in sorted native-site roster including endpoints
